Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.
  • Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.
  • U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.
  • A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.
  • Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

Description

Prime Air is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive airworthiness certification programs for the MK30 unmanned aircraft system. You will own the plans, schedules, and compliance tracking that turn certification strategy into execution. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and regulatory compliance. You will coordinate across software, hardware, systems, and test teams to keep certification deliverables on track and surface risks early.

A key dimension of this role is international regulatory coordination. Prime Air operates across multiple countries, each with its own aviation authority and certification expectations. You will manage the programs that drive international approvals of the drone system. You will track regulatory deltas across jurisdictions and maximize reuse of compliance evidence, so each country is not run as a separate program.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering Certification.

Key job responsibilities

Own the plans, schedules, and compliance matrices for Prime Air's certification programs across DO-178C (software), DO-254 (hardware), and DO-160G (environmental qualification).

Track certification objectives against engineering deliverables. Identify gaps and dependencies early, and drive them to closure.

Partner with engineering teams to sequence certification work within the development lifecycle. Escalate schedule and resource risks to leadership.

Build and maintain the status reporting, metrics, and dashboards that give leadership visibility into certification progress

Coordinate the programs that support regulatory engagement across the markets Prime Air operates in (EASA, CASA, DGCA, CAA, JCAB, and others).

Track regulatory requirements and deltas across authorities. Manage the evidence reuse plan that supports bilateral validation processes (for example, FAA-to-EASA) to reduce international approval timelines.

Monitor emerging regulations (for example, EU U-Space, FAA BVLOS rulemaking) and fold new requirements into program plans before they become blockers.

Drive alignment across engineering, regulatory, and certification teams on scope, milestones, and means of compliance.

Support the Senior Manager and certification engineers in preparing compliance arguments and documentation for the FAA, EASA, and international DERs/CVEs.

Establish and improve the program mechanisms that scale certification delivery as Prime Air expands internationally.

About the team

This is a new organization within Prime Air to own the technical execution of certification to support our world-wide expansion focus in 2027 and beyond.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

- Experience in industry work in a related environment

Description

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is on a mission to build the most advanced last-mile delivery network in the world. Our Central Engineering – Robotics & Innovation team is at the forefront of this transformation, developing and deploying automation and robotic systems that power delivery stations across North America and beyond. Our objective is to fully automate our Delivery Stations, achieving zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) operations end-to-end.

We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and customer-obsessed Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of robotics and automation programs — from early ideation and concept validation through large-scale field deployment and performance ramp-up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic program leadership with deep technical engagement across robotics, mechatronics, controls, and software disciplines.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and want to make a measurable difference in how Amazon delivers to customers — come help us make history.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end program management for robotics and automation initiatives across the AMZL delivery station network - scope, schedule, cost, risk, and performance.

Lead cross-functional teams spanning hardware engineering, software development, controls, operations, RME, process engineering, and external vendors to deliver integrated robotic solutions at scale.

Drive the full technology lifecycle: ideation to concept design to prototyping to pilot validation to GA deployment to continuous performance improvement.

Define pilot criteria, success metrics, and GO/NO-GO frameworks for new automation technologies entering the AMZL network.

Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans, including critical path scheduling, resource planning, and sequencing, validated through simulation and modeling tools.

Author business cases and strategic narratives for introducing new automation to the delivery station network; present to Director- and VP-level audiences.

Capture voice-of-the-customer directly from field operations (Ops, Maintenance, ACES, Process Engineering, Associates) and translate insights into actionable engineering and roadmap improvements.

Partner with BI and Data Engineering teams to establish KPI frameworks and performance visibility dashboards for deployed robotic systems.

Drive continuous improvement across deployment cycle time, system reliability, and operational throughput, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable efficiency gains.

Lead technical design reviews; propose and influence solution architectures for robotic cells, autonomous vehicles, material handling, and sortation systems.

Manage contractor and vendor relationships; ensure delivery commitments are met to quality, timeline, and cost targets.

Lead value engineering initiatives to minimize CAPEX while maintaining performance standards.

Travel 25-50% to delivery stations and partner sites across North America for field validation, deployment support, and stakeholder engagement.

A day in the life

Your day could start with a technical design review for a robotic induction system being piloted at in delivery station, shift to a vendor alignment call on a mechatronics integration timeline, and end with drafting a VP-level narrative on program status for a quarterly business review. You are the connective tissue between the engineers building the future of AMZL and the operators running it today - making sure what we invent actually works at Amazon scale, safely and reliably.

It's always Day 1.

About the team

The Robotics and Innovation team within AMZL Central Engineering develops and deploys automation solutions that drive our objective of fully automated, zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) delivery-station operations, eliminating manual risk and unlocking throughput at scale. We are part of the Worldwide (WW) AMZL team, partnering closely with peer Robotics and Innovation organizations across geographies to share technology, standards, and best practices.

We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It is a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases to understanding the deep human machine interfaces.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Bachelor's degree

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs involving robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware systems

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition end-to-end

- Experience working directly with engineering teams (hardware, software, controls) through the full product development lifecycle

- Experience managing vendors, contractors, and external technology partners

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- Experience deploying robotics, autonomous vehicles, sortation, or industrial automation in a fulfillment, logistics, or manufacturing environment

- Experience with simulation and modeling tools (e.g., AnyLogic, SIM3D, NavisWorks, or equivalent)

- Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing, or equivalent continuous improvement methodologies

- Experience building business cases for technology adoption, including ROI modeling and pilot framework design

- Experience with Machine Learning, IoT, or AI-enabled automation platforms is a plus

title: HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead based in the United States .

The HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead will drive health, safety, and environmental excellence across a growing portfolio of data center construction projects. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with strategic portfolio oversight to ensure safe, compliant, and reliable infrastructure delivery. You will establish consistent safety standards, strengthen contractor accountability, and translate performance data into actionable improvements across multiple sites. Working closely with engineering, construction, commissioning, and Operations teams, you will help manage critical risks and ensure facilities are ready for operational handoff. You will also lead cross-site reviews, support incident investigations, and promote continuous improvement in environmental compliance and safety performance. This is an opportunity to influence large-scale infrastructure development while fostering a proactive safety culture in a dynamic, fast-paced, and remote-friendly environment.

Accountabilities

Develop and implement a consistent portfolio-wide HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training, escalation procedures, and alignment with established environmental, health, and safety standards.

Interpret applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements, translate them into practical site-level controls, and verify compliance throughout construction, commissioning, and operational handoff.

Collaborate with site leaders and technical specialists to assess high-risk activities, validate critical safety controls, and escalate unsafe conditions involving electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting operations, excavation, and simultaneous construction and operational activities.

Establish and maintain portfolio performance indicators and reporting processes covering HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure, and operational readiness, ensuring consistent definitions and reliable data.

Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, assess compliance with agreed standards, and implement improvement plans with clear ownership, milestones, and follow-up.

Plan and coordinate risk-based site audits, assurance activities, and contractor reviews; support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions, and share lessons learned across the portfolio.

Coordinate environmental compliance activities, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls, and applicable permit requirements, in partnership with site teams and subject-matter experts.

Define HSE readiness requirements for the transition from construction to commissioning and Operations, ensuring appropriate training, procedures, emergency preparedness, risk documentation, and transfer of required records.

Provide clear performance updates and strategic recommendations to leadership, identify emerging risks and resource requirements, and strengthen safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors, and service providers.

Requirements:

Significant experience leading HSE programs for major construction projects or complex industrial environments, including multi-site operations, portfolio oversight, and contractor performance management.

Strong working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with demonstrated experience translating regulatory requirements into practical controls and verifying their implementation across construction, commissioning, and operational interfaces.

Practical understanding of data center, mission-critical infrastructure, or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control, and high-risk construction activities.

Proven ability to develop and manage HSE assurance frameworks, performance reporting systems, corrective-action programs, and leading and lagging safety indicators to improve outcomes.

Experience coordinating contractors, site leadership, and cross-functional specialists to support commissioning and operational handoff, with the ability to establish clear accountability across organizational boundaries.

Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and the ability to explain technical risks, influence stakeholders, and prioritize actions in rapidly evolving environments.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining consistent safety and compliance standards across multiple projects and teams.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience in owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models.

Familiarity with integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness, and HSE management systems into construction delivery and operational readiness programs.

Relevant professional certifications, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise.

Family and caregiver support: Up to 24 weeks of paid parental leave for birth parents and 20 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus up to eight weeks of paid medical and caregiver leave.

Health and well-being: Mental health and wellness support, employer-paid basic life and disability coverage, and additional wellness-related benefits where applicable.

Professional development: An annual learning and development stipend to support ongoing skills development and career growth.

Additional perks: Office meals and eligible meal delivery credits, relocation assistance for eligible employees, charitable donation matching, and other potential taxable fringe benefits.

Remote flexibility: A US-based remote work arrangement that supports collaboration across geographically distributed teams.

description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning and mechanism or framework creation

- Experience with increasing efficiency through AI and automation.

Trust and Privacy TPM, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility

Job ID: 10592049 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our India-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.

- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.

- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.

- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.

- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life

As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team

Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 2+ years of software development experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales.

What you'll be doing

  • Ownership and responsibility

    • Own top level execution and delivery of assigned programs.

    • Partner with project and discipline leads on cross-department programs to ensure execution on schedule and within budget.

    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments.

    • Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc.

  • Manage uncertainty and risk

    • Identify risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs.

    • Support general program management training across the organization.

Your Profile

  • Leadership experience

    • Over 6 years of experience, including more than 4 years managing the delivery of complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a program management role.

    • Lead programs coordinating across functions and departments.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one.

    • Translate a long-term strategy into an execution plan for your program teams.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Bring together world-class technical experts and project leads to execute on highly complex programs.

  • Technical Background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

    • Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating program management ideas to highly technical people.

    • Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues across the organization - Product, Research and Development, Operations, Management team, etc.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Software TPM (B2B2C)
description:
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with strong Product thinking to drive inline's Table Management System (TMS) and Food Ordering (FO) products, together with our global partner integrations.
The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and scaling the products that power restaurants' front-of-house operations — reservations, table management, queuing, deposits & payments, and food ordering — while connecting inline to a growing ecosystem of global partners such as booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls, and regional restaurant groups. The key to this role is orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder programs that serve merchants, patrons, and partners at once, and turning deep F&B domain knowledge into product decisions that improve merchant operations and patron experiences across markets.
Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

title: Learning Transformation Portfolio Delivery Lead (18 months FTC)
description:
Learning Transformation Portfolio Delivery Lead (18 months FTC)

Macclesfield, United Kingdom  (3 days on site per week)

 

About AstraZeneca

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening new ways to work, pioneering innovative methods and bringing unexpected teams together.

 

Lead the delivery of a global enterprise learning transformation portfolio, with the replacement of the global Learning Management System as the immediate and primary licence-to-operate programme. Alongside the LMS, you will oversee the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem, ensuring the programmes operate as an integrated portfolio and deliver measurable, sustainable enterprise outcomes.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions, you will lead the portfolio delivery function, integrating plans, resources, investment, risks, dependencies, decisions and benefits. You will direct Programme Managers and the PMO, establish clear delivery standards and priorities, and provide the assurance and executive insight required to keep this complex transformation focused and on course.

 

You will create an environment where governance enables timely decisions, risks surface early and interdependent programmes delivery at a global scale, shaping how learning services and technology evolve across the enterprise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio strategy, integration and planning: Define and lead the portfolio’s end-to-end delivery approach, integrated master plan, operating model, decision rights and pathways. Translate strategic priorities into sequenced programme outcomes, with the global LMS replacement as the immediate delivery priority, while maintaining momentum across Learning Content Services and the learning ecosystem refresh. Direct Programme Managers and the PMO, align resources and suppliers, and maintain robust baselines, and change control.

Global LMS delivery, compliance and operational readiness: Hold portfolio-level accountability for orchestrating and assuring the successful delivery of the global LMS replacement as a critical licence-to-operate programme. Direct integrated delivery across business, IT, Quality, data, suppliers, change and operations, ensuring effective control of validation, migration, deployment and operational readiness. Safeguard compliance, data integrity and service continuity, and enable a controlled transition to live operation and sustained adoption.

Content Services and learning ecosystem transformation: Lead and assure the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem. Ensure each programme has clear outcomes, accountable leadership, delivery plans and controls, and that technology, content, data, process and service-design decisions remain aligned across the portfolio.

Governance, assurance and systemic risk: Establish and implement proportionate governance, delivery controls, stage gates and escalation thresholds across the portfolio. Oversee risks, issues and cross-programme dependencies' end to end, resolving recurring concerns at source and raising material decisions and trade-offs with evidence-based recommendations.

Financial, resource and commercial control: Lead all aspects of portfolio budgets, forecasts, capacity and supplier performance, ensuring investment and resources remain aligned to delivery priorities. Partner with Finance, Procurement and People teams to handle constraints and variances and recommend timely trade-offs across programmes.

Performance, executive insight and value: Lead the portfolio performance and benefits framework, providing a forward-looking view of delivery, readiness, compliance, adoption and value. Translate complexity into clear choices for the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions and governance forums, and provide service owners with the evidence required for transition, operational acceptance and benefits realisation.

Organisational leadership and delivery capability: Build a high-performing Programme Management and PMO community with clear accountability and consistently applied delivery standards. Strengthen capability through development, organisational design and resourcing, while ensuring effective succession, knowledge transfer and delivery continuity.

 

Requirements:

Bachelors degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in programme management, project management, business, technology, learning, HR, organizational change, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or recognised programme or portfolio management certification is desirable.

Senior programme or portfolio leadership experience delivering complex, global, technology-enabled transformation.

Hands on experience leading the implementation or replacement of a global LMS, HR platform or comparable business-critical enterprise system, including delivery in a regulated environment.

Strong understanding of the delivery controls required for validation, data migration, compliance, operational readiness and transition of a business-critical global platform.

Ability to establish integrated portfolio plans, operating models, governance, performance management and execution at enterprise scale.

Experience leading a complex, multi-year transformation portfolio from strategy through to delivery, including defining the operating model, integrated master plan, decision rights, and governance.

Experience leading Programme Managers and PMO professionals, building organisational capability and delivering outcomes through others.

Experience integrating delivery across business, technology, data, Quality, suppliers, change and operations.

Executive presence and commercial judgement, with the ability to present evidence-based recommendations and make informed trade-offs.

 

In Office Requirement:

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

 

Competitive salary and benefits package on offer!

The successful candidate will have access to a flexible employee benefits fund, including holiday purchase and flexible time off, pension contributions, Share Save Plans, A performance recognition scheme and a competitive, generous remuneration package!

title: Global Senior Program Manager

Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. 

 

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. 

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. 

In addition, we offer: 

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. 

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.  

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). 

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. 

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. 

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. 

 

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.  

 

Furthermore, we are looking for: 

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.  

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.  

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.  

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.  

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. 

 

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch! 

 

Serious Tech 
At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues. 

 

We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement. 

 

Seriously you?

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.
